name: Dwarven Resilience
desc: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.
content: Dwarven Resilience (DR) is a trait that grants Dwarves (DW) the ability to have advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage. This trait showcases the resilience and toughness of Dwarves, making them highly resistant to the harmful effects of poison. DW's natural affinity for resisting poison aligns with their hardy nature, making them formidable allies in any adventure or battle.

name: Stonecunning
desc: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.
content: Stonecunning trait grants Dwarves proficiency in Intelligence (History) checks related to stonework origins, doubling their proficiency bonus. This trait is specific to the Dwarf race and enhances their History skill.

name: Dwarven Toughness
desc: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.
content: Dwarven Toughness trait grants a bonus to hit points for Hill Dwarves, increasing by 1 with each level gained. This trait does not provide proficiencies.

name: Darkvision
desc: You have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You cannot discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
content: Darkvision trait provides superior vision in dark and dim conditions, allowing you to see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. This trait is possessed by races such as Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Half-Elf, Half-Orc, and Tiefling. While darkvision enhances your sight, it limits color perception in darkness to shades of gray.

name: Keen Senses
desc: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
content: The Keen Senses trait grants proficiency in the Perception skill, allowing the Elf race to excel in detecting subtle details and hidden threats. This trait is a valuable asset for those who prioritize awareness and keen observation in their adventures. The Elf race embodies grace, agility, and a deep connection to the natural world, making them skilled in perceiving their surroundings with heightened senses.

name: Fey Ancestry
desc: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic cannot put you to sleep.
content: Fey Ancestry (FA) grants individuals of Elf (E) and Half-Elf (HE) races advantage on saving throws against charm and immunity to sleep-inducing magic. This trait enhances resistance to enchantments and showcases the magical lineage of those with elven blood. No specific proficiencies or subraces are tied to this ancestry, emphasizing its universal application across different elf-related races.

name: Trance
desc: Elves do not need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. (The Common word for such meditation is "trance.") While meditating, you can dream after a fashion; such dreams are actually mental exercises that have become reflexive through years of practice. After resting this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.
content: The Trance trait allows Elves to meditate deeply for 4 hours a day instead of sleeping, gaining the same benefits as 8 hours of sleep. This state of semiconsciousness, known as a "trance," allows Elves to dream and engage in mental exercises reflexively. Elves, being a race with a natural affinity for magic and agility, do not require as much rest as other races due to their innate abilities.

name: Dwarven Combat Training
desc: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.
content: Dwarven Combat Training trait grants proficiency with the battleaxe (Battleaxes), handaxe (Handaxes), light hammer (Light hammers), and warhammer (Warhammers), exclusive to the Dwarf race. This trait enhances combat skills and weapon proficiency, making Dwarves formidable warriors on the battlefield.

name: Elf Weapon Training
desc: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.
content: Elf Weapon Training grants proficiency with the longsword (longswords), shortsword (shortswords), shortbow (shortbows), and longbow (longbows) to individuals such as High Elves, enhancing their combat capabilities with these specific weapons. This trait is valuable for those seeking versatility and effectiveness in ranged and melee combat scenarios.

name: Lucky
desc: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
content: The Lucky trait allows you to reroll a d20 when you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, potentially changing the outcome. This trait is associated with the Halfling race, known for their luck and nimbleness. Lucky can be a valuable asset in critical moments, giving you a second chance to succeed where you initially failed.

name: Brave
desc: You have advantage on saving throw against being frightened.
content: The Brave trait grants you advantage on saving throws against being frightened, making you resilient in the face of fear. This trait is associated with the Halfling race, known for their courage and determination. With no specified subraces or proficiencies, Brave stands out as a straightforward yet impactful ability that can help you overcome challenges in your adventures.

name: Halfling Nimbleness
desc: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.
content: Halfling Nimbleness trait allows a Halfling to move through the space of creatures larger than themselves. This trait is specific to the Halfling race and does not provide any additional proficiencies or subraces. It is represented by the unique ID 65f4e07ecaf62545890fef02 and can be accessed through the URL /api/traits/halfling-nimbleness. The trait is associated with the Halfling race, which is known for its nimbleness and agility.

name: Naturally Stealthy
desc: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.
content: The Naturally Stealthy trait grants the ability to hide when obscured by a creature at least one size larger than you, enhancing stealth capabilities. This trait is associated with the Lightfoot Halfling subrace, allowing for increased maneuverability in stealthy situations. Additionally, the trait does not provide any specific proficiencies or racial bonuses, focusing solely on stealth-related abilities.

name: High Elf Cantrip
desc: You know one cantrip of your choice form the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.
content: The High Elf Cantrip trait allows High Elves to choose one cantrip from the wizard spell list, with Intelligence being their spellcasting ability for it. The available options include Light, Mage Hand, Mending, Message, Minor Illusion, Acid Splash, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp, True Strike, Chill Touch, Dancing Lights, Fire Bolt, and Poison Spray. This trait is associated with the High Elf subrace and provides a versatile magical ability for those who possess it.

name: Tool Proficiency
desc: You gain proficiency with the artisan's tools of your choice: smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.
content: The Tool Proficiency trait grants proficiency with artisan's tools such as Smith's Tools, Brewer's Supplies, or Mason's Tools, allowing the character to choose one of these options. This trait is associated with the Dwarf race and provides a choice of one proficiency from a set of options.

name: Extra Language
desc: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.
content: The "Extra Language" trait allows a character to speak, read, and write one additional language of their choice. This trait is part of the "extra-language" index and provides language options to choose from, including Dwarvish, Giant, Gnomish, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, Abyssal, Celestial, Draconic, Deep Speech, Infernal, Primordial, Sylvan, and Undercommon. The subrace associated with this trait is the High Elf, providing a versatile linguistic advantage in various settings. This trait does not offer any proficiencies but enhances a character's communication skills and cultural understanding.

name: Draconic Ancestry (Blue)
desc: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon from the Draconic Ancestry table. Your breath weapon and damage resistance are determined by the dragon type, as shown in the table.

breath_weapon.name: Breath Weapon
breath_weapon.desc: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy. Your draconic ancestry determines the size, shape, and damage type of the exhalation. When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a saving throw, the type of which is determined by your draconic ancestry. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes 2d6 damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th level, and 5d6 at 16th level. After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

content: Draconic Ancestry (Blue) grants you the traits of a Dragonborn, with Lightning as your damage type and Breath Weapon as your special ability. Your Breath Weapon allows you to exhale destructive energy in a line of 30 feet, causing 2d6 damage at level 1, increasing to 5d6 at level 16. The DC for the saving throw is determined by your Dexterity score. This trait can be used once per rest, with successful saves resulting in half damage. Embrace your draconic heritage and unleash the power of lightning with this ancestry.

name: Artificer's Lore
desc: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.
content: Artificer's Lore is a trait that enhances Intelligence (History) checks regarding magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices by allowing the addition of twice the proficiency bonus instead of the standard bonus. This trait is associated with the subrace Rock Gnome, providing a unique advantage for those with a knack for understanding the intricacies of magical and technological artifacts.

name: Damage Resistance
desc: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.
content: Dragonborn have the trait Damage Resistance, granting them resistance to the damage type linked to their draconic ancestry. This trait is associated with the Dragonborn race and is represented by the ID 65f4e07ecaf62545890fef14. The trait does not have any subraces or proficiencies listed.

name: Tinker
desc: You have proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 hp). The device ceases to function after 24 hours (unless you spend 1 hour repairing it to keep the device functioning), or when you use your action to dismantle it; at that time, you can reclaim the materials used to create it. You can have up to three such devices active at a time.
When you create a device, choose one of the following options:

Clockwork Toy: This toy is a clockwork animal, monster, or person, such as a frog, mouse, bird, dragon, or soldier. When placed on the ground, the toy moves 5 feet across the ground on each of your turns in a random direction. It makes noises as appropriate to the creature it represents.
Fire Starter: The device produces a miniature flame, which you can use to light a candle, torch, or campfire. Using the device requires your action.
Music Box: When opened, this music box plays a single song at a moderate volume. The box stops playing when it reaches the song's end or when it is closed.
content: The Tinker trait allows you to create clockwork devices using Tinker's Tools, which you have proficiency in. These devices can be clockwork toys, fire starters, or music boxes, each with unique functions. You can have up to three active devices at a time, and they cease to function after 24 hours unless repaired. The devices can be dismantled to reclaim materials. This trait enhances your crafting abilities and creativity, making you a skilled artisan with a knack for intricate mechanical creations.

name: Menacing
desc: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.
content: The Menacing trait grants proficiency in the Intimidation skill, enhancing your ability to intimidate others. This trait is associated with the Half-Orc race, known for their intimidating presence and strength. By embodying the qualities of a Half-Orc, you exude a sense of power and authority that can be used to your advantage in various situations. Mastering the art of intimidation can help you navigate social interactions and assert your dominance when needed.

name: Relentless Endurance
desc: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. you cannot use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
content: Relentless Endurance is a trait that allows a character, specifically a Half-Orc race, to withstand being reduced to 0 hit points by dropping to 1 hit point instead, once per long rest. This trait embodies resilience and tenacity, providing a crucial lifeline in dire situations. It does not grant any proficiencies or subraces, but its impact on survivability is undeniable. A valuable asset in combat scenarios, Relentless Endurance emphasizes the endurance and fortitude of its possessor, making them a formidable force on the battlefield.

name: Savage Attacks
desc: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.
content: The Savage Attacks trait allows Half-Orc characters to roll an additional damage dice when scoring a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, enhancing the extra damage dealt. This trait showcases the Half-Orc's prowess in combat and synergizes well with their natural strength and proficiency with melee weapons.

name: Hellish Resistance
desc: You have resistance to fire damage.
content: The trait Hellish Resistance grants Tieflings resistance to fire damage, making them more resilient against such attacks. This trait is associated with the Tiefling race and does not provide any additional proficiencies or subraces.

name: Infernal Legacy
desc: You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the hellish rebuke spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the darkness spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
content: The Infernal Legacy trait grants tieflings the ability to cast thaumaturgy cantrip, hellish rebuke spell, and darkness spell at certain levels, with Charisma as their spellcasting ability. This trait allows tieflings to regain spellcasting abilities after finishing a long rest, showcasing their innate magical prowess. Tieflings with the Infernal Legacy trait embody a dark and mysterious power, making them formidable spellcasters in any adventure.

name: Skill Versatility
desc: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.
content: The Skill Versatility trait allows Half-Elves to gain proficiency in two skills of their choice, selected from a wide range of options including Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Arcana, Athletics, Deception, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Performance, Persuasion, Religion, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, and Survival. This trait provides flexibility and adaptability for Half-Elves, enhancing their abilities in various areas of expertise.
